Personal data map

Drafted from the code by pii-eu test. It shows which personal data the code keeps, where it goes and what needs a decision. It shows field names and file locations, never the data itself.

The code keeps personal data in 1 store, names 2 outside companies and writes personal data to logs in 1 place. Kinds of personal data: names. Special-category data (GDPR Art. 9): health data.

Needs a decision

These come from the whole map. Save the map as JSON and use --diff next time to see only what is new. Each item says why it matters and what to decide.

  1. Special-category data: health data in services/clinic

    Why it matters: Health data is special-category data (GDPR Art. 9), which may only be processed under one of the exceptions in Art. 9(2).

    To decide: Decide the purpose, which Art. 9(2) exception applies and whether a data protection impact assessment is needed.

    services/clinic/db/001.sql, line 4

  2. Outside company: Stripe (payments)

    Why it matters: The code in services/billing names Stripe, so personal data may be sent to it. It is not established in the EEA.

    To decide: Check there is a processor agreement (GDPR Art. 28) and that it is listed as a recipient. Also check the safeguard for transfers outside the EEA (Chapter V).

    services/billing/requirements.txt, line 2

  3. Outside company: Mistral AI (AI model provider)

    Why it matters: The code in services/clinic names Mistral AI, so personal data may be sent to it.

    To decide: Check there is a processor agreement (GDPR Art. 28) and that it is listed as a recipient.

    services/clinic/notes.py, line 1

  4. Store without erasure or retention: patients in services/clinic

    Why it matters: No code was found that removes old data from patients.

    To decide: Decide how long this data is kept and ask for a retention limit (GDPR Art. 5(1)(e)).

    services/clinic/db/001.sql, line 3

  5. Cloud store: aws_s3_bucket.patient_exports in services/clinic

    Why it matters: It holds personal data and has no rule that deletes old data and is outside the EEA (us-east-1).

    To decide: Decide whether to set a retention limit and move it to an EU region or record the transfer safeguard.

    services/clinic/infra/main.tf, line 4

  6. Personal data in logs: contact details such as email or phone in services/billing

    Why it matters: The code writes contact details such as email or phone to logs or telemetry, which are often kept longer and seen by more people than the data itself.

    To decide: Decide whether logs may hold this data; if not, ask for it to be removed or masked.

    services/billing/api.py, line 9
